title: rosa canina var. yebalica
intro: Rosa canina var. yebalica, commonly known as Yebal rosehip, is a variety of the Rosa canina plant, a species of rose native to the Iberian Peninsula and North Africa. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its ability to boost the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Yebal rosehip include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which make it useful in treating various conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Yebal rosehip include flavonoids, carotenoids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
